notes: JOINT-BUILD record: cost covers AddCCBlock+SubCCBlock (shared module, one commit); SubCCBlock's record is a zero-cost cross-reference. 1 attempt per block, first-try bit-exact, autonomous. The historical 4-operand wall is now QUANTIFIED (~39/32 words single-cell) and DODGED: the engine forces ONE landing cell, so the per-rail decomposition lives downstream of the landing cell's counting join (rail_i computes+forwards, rail_q computes+emits the packet). Landed the reusable two-external-complex-stream harness (run_block_dut_complex2 + _pipelined) for the MultiplyCC dispatch. REAL importer bug found+fixed: GRC numeric port indices count COMPLEX ports but _resolve_port indexed raw scalar ports — two-stream complex wiring crossed rails (stream b's yi onto stream a's aq). Saturation = NEEDS_BESPOKE with a bespoke saturated==per-sample gate (shared harnesses would half-fire the counting join). 67 tests. Token figure cumulative per harness.
